purpose: Separate short weekly BTC trend switches from durable price-only structural expansion/contraction; test breadth sequencing and prepare PIT macro data joins.
timeAndSource: Only fully completed UTC Sunday Coin Metrics BTC PriceUSD fixings from pinned 814 weekly rows. No current intraday, no cross-venue executable price. Different daily/wk sources never combined.
series: Construct on each t ≥ 64th eligible weekly Sunday: 52 fully observed Sunday closing prices SMA52(t); SMA52(t-13) from entirely earlier 52 completed Sunday prices; BTC 26w trailing return close(t)/close(t-26)-1. Avoid using any current week whose Sunday not closed.

rawStructuralRules.notBullGroundTruth: A 52-week price context proxy, NOT a independently verified bull/bear market definition.

confirmation: Consecutive 4 raw closed-week structural labels required before confirmed state switches. First label confirmed only after 4 consecutive observations. Ignore missing history, no backdating. After confirmation retain last confirmed regime while raw differs (with current mismatch marked PENDING).
episodeMetrics: Raw and confirmed stage events, time from first raw candidate to confirmation, durations until next confirmed transition (never retroactively assign older state to candidate)

All weekly v8.7 entering events linked to confirmed structural state as known at that same week, and measured following 13/26 weeks BTC price returns / worst daily-close drawdown from parent v8.6, separately by structural state

Full available breadth on the same fully closed week, fraction of broadParticipation true by structural state (only complete fixed 8-asset data, others UNKNOWN). 13w subsequent broadening for weekly ENTRY uses parent v8.7 method only if full future and all other seven sources existed.
Fewer than 20 events per cohort means LOW_SAMPLE, no probability or OOS inference.
Optional annual counts and 2011-2016 / 2017-2019 / 2020-2023 / 2024-2026 eras without optimizing thresholds.
controlComparators: RAW weekly BTC trend boolean from frozen v8.6; 4w weekly persistence confirmations from frozen v8.8; no trade execution. Compare stage assignment of weekly churn (fast flags versus slow confirmed states) to quantify switching not predictive accuracy.
current: Last full Sunday 2026-10-11. Report raw structural, confirmed structural, last confirmed change, raw mismatch and present weekly flag, alt breadth and if not confirmed which candidate week in progress.

macroPITSourceAudit.H4.1: Official Federal Reserve release archive since 1996, sample selected early and later dated release URLs, preserve publication date and page SHA if retrieved; ALFRED H4.1 has vintage availability.
macroPITSourceAudit.NFCI: Chicago Fed index vintages via ALFRED; series initially published May 2011 per release archive; pre-2011 current backfilled index is NOT an available real-time feature.
macroPITSourceAudit.WALCL: ALFRED (keyed FRED/series/observations) API requires genuine key; do not claim completed PIT study without it.
macroPITSourceAudit.ETF: BTC Spot ETFs only since January 2024; previous v8.5.1 backfilled Farside is not true point-in-time, cannot upgrade validity.

sampleIntegrity: Pinned parent JSON SHA must match
814 weekly dates Sunday and gaps zero
Freeze all threshold definitions BEFORE report execution
All per-event future windows right-censored if unavailable
R2 run-scoped report with readback SHA and status
restrictions: No calibrated probabilities or validated big bull market declaration from price-only proxy
